main.remarks: An immutable access-key assertion that stores raw token evidence together with normalized issuer, audience, scope, tenant, subject, and authentication metadata extracted at issue time.

property.name: SerializationIdentifier
property.summary: Stable registry identifier used by the assertion envelope for token payload dispatch.

property.name: AuthenticationContextClassReference
property.summary: OIDC authentication context class reference (`acr`) if present.

property.name: Audiences
property.summary: Normalized audiences carried by the token assertion.

property.name: AuthenticationMethods
property.summary: Normalized authentication methods carried by the token assertion.

property.name: AuthenticationTime
property.summary: Authentication instant if present; otherwise null.

property.name: IssuedAt
property.summary: Assertion issuance instant if present; otherwise null.

property.name: NotAfter
property.summary: Assertion expiration instant if present; otherwise null.

property.name: NotBefore
property.summary: Assertion not-before instant if present; otherwise null.

property.name: Scopes
property.summary: Normalized scopes carried by the token assertion.

property.name: Token
property.summary: Raw token bytes carried by the assertion.

field.name: token
field.summary: Backing storage for cloned token bytes.

method.name: Copy
method.summary: Create a copy of the token assertion.

method.name: HasAuthenticationMethod
method.summary: Determine whether the token assertion contains a normalized authentication method.
method.returns: True if the authentication method is present; otherwise false.

method.name: IsExpiredAt
method.summary: Determine whether the token assertion would be expired at a specific instant.
method.param: Instant to test against the assertion expiration time.
method.returns: True if the assertion has an expiration time and that time is before the supplied instant; otherwise false.

method.name: SerializePayload
method.summary: Serialize the token assertion payload into the private concrete contract used by the base assertion envelope.

method.name: ToSummary
method.summary: Project the token assertion into its runtime summary representation.

method.name: DeserializePayload
method.summary: Reconstruct a token assertion from serialized payload bytes.
method.returns: Reconstructed token assertion, or null if payload deserialization fails.

field.name: SerializationIdentifierValue
field.summary: Stable registry identifier for the token assertion payload contract.
